data.description: The ABB Trainer is an outdoor bench for abdominal exercises, with a curved orange backrest. Users lie or sit against the curve and lift the upper body or legs, so it works the core without any moving parts. That makes it a low-maintenance addition to an open gym in a society, school or college. It suits teenagers and adults; older users may prefer the twisters for gentler core work. It is finished in Play Orange and belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Our team will send its size and warranty terms along with the quote. Under our standard terms, galvanised pipes have a 3-year warranty. Ask us to add the ABB Trainer to your layout.

items.pText: The ABB Trainer is an outdoor bench for abdominal exercises, with a curved orange backrest. Users lie or sit against the curve and lift the upper body or legs, so it works the core without any moving parts. That makes it a low-maintenance addition to an open gym in a society, school or college. It suits teenagers and adults; older users may prefer the twisters for gentler core work. It is finished in Play Orange and belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Our team will send its size and warranty terms along with the quote. Under our standard terms, galvanised pipes have a 3-year warranty. Ask us to add the ABB Trainer to your layout.

With no bearings or pivots, the ABB Trainer needs very little maintenance beyond checking the fixings and keeping the backrest clean. It can be self-standing or grouted. Place it on a level surface and leave space at the head and foot ends for users getting on and off.
